description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“Paradise Found 30A,” an exceptional pet-friendly retreat tucked away in the quiet community of Seacrest West. Thoughtfully designed for effortless coastal living, this beautifully appointed 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath home comfortably sleeps up to 14 guests and offers every detail needed for an unforgettable 30A escape. Spend sun-soaked afternoons beside your private, seasonally heated pool, gather for al fresco dinners beneath the covered cabana or cruise to the beach on one of the 7 included bikes. With elevator access to every floor, a fully fenced backyard for your four-legged companions and deeded beach access just a 3-minute stroll away, "Paradise Found 30A" delivers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort and laid-back beach living. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Quiet Seacrest West Location just a 3-minute stroll or quick bike ride to deeded beach accessPrivate Backyard Oasis featuring a seasonally heated pool, covered cabana and resort-style outdoor livingPet-Friendly Paradise with a fully fenced backyard so every member of the family can enjoy vacationSleeps 14 Comfortably with 5 spacious bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms and multiple gathering spaces across three levelsElevator Access to Every Floor making arrivals, departures and unpacking effortlessChef's Kitchen & Outdoor Kitchen thoughtfully designed for entertaining indoors and out7 Bikes Included for exploring Seacrest, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Scenic Highway 30A*** LIVING AREAS ***Designed with gathering in mind, "Paradise Found 30A" offers inviting spaces where everyone can relax after a day at the beach. The open-concept main living area creates the perfect place to connect, while the additional downstairs living space provides even more room for families and groups to spread out and unwind.Spacious open-concept main living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVAdditional first-floor living area with sectional seating, flat-screen TV and convenient kitchenetteMultiple gathering spaces designed for families and groups*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you're preparing breakfast before heading to the beach or gathering around the table after a day in the sun, the beautifully appointed chef's kitchen offers everything needed to cook, entertain and enjoy time together.Stainless steel appliances, gas range and generous counter spaceDining table with seating for 12 plus bar seating for 4First-floor kitchenette with an ice maker and wine cooler, plus a covered outdoor kitchen and al fresco dining overlooking the private pool*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Five beautifully appointed bedrooms are thoughtfully spread across three levels, offering families and groups the perfect balance of privacy, comfort and flexibility. Each suite provides its own inviting retreat after another unforgettable day along 30A.First FloorQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerConvenient Half Bath located under the poolside cabanaSecond FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bath conveniently located off the kitchenThird FloorBunk Suite: Three Twin-over-Twin bunk beds and En-suite with dual vanities and shower/tub comboKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite: King bed, sitting area, flat-screen TV, private balcony with Gulf views and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The outdoor living spaces at "Paradise Found 30A" are designed to be just as enjoyable as the home itself. Lounge beside the private, seasonally heated pool, gather around the outdoor kitchen while dinner is on the grill or relax beneath the covered cabana after a day at the beach. With multiple spaces to dine, entertain and unwind, the fully fenced backyard also gives your four-legged family members plenty of room to safely stretch their legs, making this the perfect outdoor retreat for everyone in your group.Private, seasonally heated pool with plenty of space to relax in the Florida sunshineCovered cabana with comfortable lounge seating, a flat-screen TV and a fully equipped outdoor kitchenCovered outdoor dining area ideal for family dinners and evenings spent togetherFully fenced backyard complete with an outdoor shower and convenient poolside half bath*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Perfectly positioned in Seacrest West, "Paradise Found 30A" places you just minutes from some of 30A's most beloved beach communities, restaurants and attractions. Spend the morning on the sugar-white sand, browse the boutiques of Rosemary Beach, enjoy dinner in Alys Beach or hop on a bike and discover everything Scenic Highway 30A has to offer.Deeded beach access just a 3-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride awayRosemary Beach with boutique shopping, coffee shops and award-winning diningAlys Beach featuring iconic white architecture, beautiful green spaces and upscale restaurantsThe Big Chill for family-friendly dining, shopping and entertainmentScenic Highway 30A bike path connecting the area's most charming beach communities*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non-shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsDogs must be kept in a crate when guests are not with themNon-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax applies*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel insurance is not included but may be purchased at checkout or separatelyWe do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool heated seasonally from September 1 through April 30Waiver required to access the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest or Alys BeachThere is an active security camera over the driveway. There is a covered, non-recording exterior camera positioned near the pool area. It is not monitored during guest stays.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
